contract_policy: Logical names only; resolve the installed connector prefix. Inspect current schemas before calling. This catalog describes capabilities and does not replace parameter schemas.

tools.name: get_context
tools.use: Empresas autorizadas, selecionada e datasets.
notes: Do not broaden the question to all authorized companies.

tools.name: resolve_entities
tools.use: Resolver nomes, endereços, MACs, códigos e IDs.
tools.scope: current or explicit authorized company_ids per schema
notes: Returns candidates; disambiguate incompatible matches.
Not a leak search or performance dataset.

tools.name: describe_data
tools.use: Campos, filtros, métricas, unidades e limites reais.
notes: Use before constructing query_data with an unknown contract.

tools.name: query_data
tools.use: Selecionar registros de oito datasets; agregar casos de vazamento.
notes: 50 default / 200 max; cursor bound to user/query, expires after 1h; offset limit 10000.
Aggregate totals cover complete population before group pagination.
Current status is not historical period-end status.
No arbitrary joins, SQL or writes.

tools.name: leak_search
tools.use: Atalho de compatibilidade para query_data(leaks).
notes: Prefer query_data for new queries.

tools.name: repair_backlog
tools.use: Estoque atual confirmado/impedido e cobertura da vazão estimada.
notes: Priority oldest, highest_flow or missing_estimate; no invented priority score.
Not historical backlog.

tools.name: compare_metrics
tools.use: Comparar métricas de vazamentos em dois recortes explícitos.
notes: Same temporal basis; percentage undefined for zero baseline.
Different window lengths are not normalized automatically.

tools.name: data_freshness
tools.use: Datas de captura, chegada, snapshot e tentativa/sucesso de localização.
notes: Inventory paginated before telemetry; sector localization coverage follows sectors on this page.
Does not query cloud scheduler or refresh snapshots.

tools.name: telemetry_quality
tools.use: Dias observados, valores ausentes/inválidos e atraso de áudio/pressão.
notes: 1–31 complete local days, captured_at basis.
Unobserved days are not missed scheduled collections.
Negative delays excluded from valid delay mean/max.

tools.name: export_monthly_leaks
tools.use: CSVs originais mensais dos scripts de vazamentos.
notes: 5000 data rows / 256KiB per file; 1MiB envelope; no partial CSV.
unrepaired: confirmed in month, never repaired. repaired: confirmed and repaired in same month.
Includes archived and first address; neither all monthly repairs nor historical backlog.
Embedded CSV resources are content, not downloadable hydrovision:// URLs.

tools.name: sector_summary
tools.use: Resumo e ranking operacional de setores.
notes: MCP removes boundary, pipes, installed_loggers and forces include_geometry=false.
Do not infer geometry support from the REST description.

tools.name: logger_performance_list
tools.use: Lista legada de desempenho com filtros específicos.
notes: Prefer query_data(logger_performance) for paginated analytical selection.
Audio/pressure filters can use OR instead of analytical AND.

tools.name: logger_performance_detail
tools.use: Amostras detalhadas de desempenho, áudio e pressão do logger.
notes: Respect REST dates and sample units; a partial series is not a complete period.

tools.name: logger_fleet_dashboard
tools.use: Panorama agregado da frota e problemas operacionais.
notes: Check included device statuses, method and snapshot freshness.

tools.name: logger_health
tools.use: Saúde calculada por testes funcionais e último dia de transmissão.
notes: Latest test execution batch, audio/pressure quality and battery; unknown is not healthy.

tools.name: logger_battery_curve
tools.use: Curva e dados de bateria do logger.
notes: Preserve returned battery units and method; do not extrapolate unsupported lifetime.

tools.name: logger_installation_images
tools.use: Fotos de instalação em blocos MCP de imagem.
notes: 1–4 attempted images per call, JPEG max 1024px.
Next offset counts attempted items, not successful downloads.
No URL download required for embedded images.

tools.name: measurement_point_billing
tools.use: Disponibilidade de pontos para faturamento.
notes: Points are not devices; availability is not a monetary bill or Accounts subscription.

tools.name: leak_list
tools.use: Lista legada de vazamentos com filtros/campos específicos.
notes: Latest-event dates differ from first-event analytical cohorts.

tools.name: leak_detail
tools.use: Caso, coordenadas, histórico, estimativas e campos configuráveis.
notes: Photo metadata/URLs do not guarantee client-accessible bytes.

tools.name: leak_summary
tools.use: Resumo legado de eventos de situação.
notes: Can count same leak multiple times; not unique cases.
Monthly blocks cover three months.

tools.name: leak_hotspots_timeline
tools.use: Quadros diários de localização; days=1 para mapa atual.
notes: MCP forces include_points=false.
Run/cluster IDs are transient; suggestion is not confirmation.

tools.name: leak_hotspots_summary
tools.use: Recorrência espacial calculada para o intervalo.
notes: Use returned geometries; do not count daily cluster IDs as unique permanent sites.

tools.name: investigation_list
tools.use: Lista leve legada de investigações.
notes: MCP forces light=true; prefer query_data(investigations) for analytical selection.

tools.name: investigation_detail
tools.use: Área, participantes, sessões, motivos, vazamentos e evidências disponíveis.
notes: No sector FK; no full track-history tool.
Metadata does not imply image/audio bytes accessible to client.

tools.name: field_sessions_live
tools.use: Sessões abertas e últimas posições de participantes.
notes: Session/participant/employee have different IDs.
Open session or old GPS is not proof of current movement.

tools.name: dashboard_management
tools.use: Blocos agregados da visão gerencial.
notes: Volume is annual projection independent of requested period.
Field work uses company scope; sector ranking ignores period.
Leak counts use confirmed cohort and its current status.

tools.name: dashboard_volume_series
tools.use: Contribuição anual projetada dos reparos de cada mês.
notes: m³/year, not measured monthly recovered volume.
Mark current partial month.
